visual.source: Mendeley Data 6ghdz52pd7 v5 Dataset.zip, test split
visual.size_rules: box area / image area: small < 1%, medium 1-10%, large > 10%
visual.labels: class from file name (B...=bird, D...=drone); duplicate same-object boxes (IoU>=0.5) merged. Published Mendeley v5 labels put both classes in one id.
visual.groups: near-duplicate frames chained at pHash Hamming <= 6; bootstrap CIs resample groups

history.note: RE-FROZE dataset/visual (old version archived as test_sets_archive/dataset_visual_2026-10-11T004658Z.json): Approved by Vivan: published Mendeley v5 labels put birds and drones in one class id (only 89 of ~380 bird boxes in test were class 1; all train/valid boxes class 0), so classes now come from file names (B=bird, D=drone) and the one doubly-annotated object (BT (21)) is merged. Near-duplicate consecutive frames (889 images -> ~176 groups) now carry a group id so bootstrap CIs resample groups. No results existed on the old freeze.
